# Freesound CC0 evidence snapshot — 2026-08-09

This public, sanitized record supports the AD2 audio selection. It contains no
account, session, download-token, or payment data. Each canonical source page
displayed `Creative Commons 0` / `CC0 1.0` when reviewed and downloaded on
`2026-08-09`.

Governing references reviewed on the same date:

- [Freesound licensing FAQ](https://freesound.org/help/faq/)
- [CC0 1.0 deed](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)
- [CC0 1.0 Legal Code](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode.en)

CC0 permits copying, modification, distribution, and commercial use without a
required attribution. It supplies no warranty and does not independently prove
that an uploader controlled every right in a recording. Echo Protocol therefore
records source descriptions, hashes, and voluntary credits and rejects unclear
or obviously re-uploaded material.
